# Raster regression fixtures

The E2E suite uses local images so tests do not need network access.

- `astronaut.png` — scikit-image sample image `data.astronaut`; NASA Great Images database, public domain / no known copyright restrictions.
- `coffee.png` — scikit-image sample image `data.coffee`; CC0, photographer Rachel Michetti (Pikolo Espresso Bar courtesy).
- `chelsea.png` — scikit-image sample image `data.chelsea`; CC0, photographer Stefan van der Walt.
- `rocket.png` — scikit-image sample image `data.rocket`; SpaceX launch photograph released into the public domain.
- `flat-graphic.png` — generated locally for geometric and palette regression tests.

Original sample descriptions and licensing notes are documented by scikit-image in `skimage.data`.
